europe_now.title: Ferry disaster off northern Cyprus leaves dozens dead and missing
europe_now.summary: A ferry carrying over 260 people capsized off northern Cyprus, killing at least eight and leaving dozens missing as rescue operations continue. The incident has triggered a major emergency response involving multiple countries.

europe_now.title: Russia reportedly preparing large-scale strikes on Ukraine’s energy infrastructure
europe_now.summary: Russian forces are allegedly planning massive attacks on Ukraine's energy facilities, according to intelligence sources. The potential escalation comes amid ongoing tensions in the region.

top_stories.title: Iceland votes against restarting EU accession talks
top_stories.summary: Icelandic voters rejected a referendum to resume negotiations on joining the European Union, marking a decisive shift in the country's foreign policy direction. The outcome reflects broader public sentiment toward deeper European integration.

top_stories.title: NATO's Arctic expansion alarms Moscow
top_stories.summary: NATO's increased military presence and activities in the Arctic region are being viewed by Russia as a direct threat to its national security. The alliance's growing footprint in the High North underscores evolving geopolitical dynamics.

top_stories.title: French far-right and far-left dominate latest opinion polls
top_stories.summary: Extremist parties across the political spectrum in France have surged in popularity according to recent surveys, challenging the traditional centrist establishment. This polarization signals a potential realignment of the country's political landscape ahead of upcoming elections.

europe_now.title: Iceland votes against restarting EU accession talks
europe_now.summary: Icelandic voters have rejected a referendum to resume European Union accession negotiations, marking a decisive shift away from potential EU membership. The outcome reflects public sentiment favoring independence over deeper integration with European institutions.

top_stories.title: NATO's Arctic expansion alarms Moscow
top_stories.summary: NATO's increasing military presence in the Arctic region has been labeled a direct threat by Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov. The warning underscores growing geopolitical friction between Western alliances and Russia over northern polar territories.

top_stories.title: Far-right and far-left dominate French political landscape
top_stories.summary: Recent opinion polls in France show the far-right and far-left parties leading over centrist and traditional mainstream parties ahead of upcoming elections. This polarization signals a potential realignment of the French electorate toward more extreme ideological positions.

top_stories.title: Ferry disaster off northern Cyprus leaves dozens dead and missing
top_stories.summary: A ferry carrying over 260 passengers capsized off the coast of northern Cyprus, resulting in multiple fatalities and many individuals reported missing. Emergency rescue operations are ongoing as authorities assess the full scale of the tragedy.
